title: Jubilant Greek Feta Lasagna
description: A sour and cheesy Greek dish featuring dasima-kombu and long-fermentation-dough, prepared in an ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly way.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Soak the dasima-kombu sheets in water for 30 minutes to rehydrate them.
Roll out the long-fermentation-dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Spread a layer of olive oil on the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Arrange a layer of feta cheese, kalamata olives, artichoke hearts, and sun-dried tomatoes on the dough.
Sprinkle a pinch of salt and a squeeze of lemon juice over the top of the layer.
Repeat the layering process two more times, ending with a layer of dough on top.
Brush the top of the dough with olive oil and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Bake the lasagna in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove the lasagna from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
